Dear prado team,

I am writing to apply for the Front-end Developer (Shopify) position. With a technical foundation in web development and a strong focus on SEO and performance, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your e-commerce growth.

In my current role at Episto, I build and maintain WordPress sites, but I have hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript from my previous front-end role at ViviDoctor. I am eager to apply my skills to Shopify, and I have been actively learning Liquid and the Online Store 2.0 architecture. My experience with structured data and technical audits aligns with your focus on Core Web Vitals and SEO.

I am fluent in English and have a B1 level in Dutch, and I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp. I am comfortable working independently and switching between tasks, and I am passionate about translating designs into seamless user experiences.

I would love to discuss how I can contribute to prado's team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear prado team,

I am excited to apply for the Front-end Developer (Shopify) position at prado. With a background in front-end development and a strong focus on SEO and performance, I am drawn to prado's mission of building invisible home technology and its rapid growth in e-commerce.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in on-page SEO, content creation, and WordPress site building. However, my true passion lies in front-end development. At ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript, giving me a solid foundation in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. I am now eager to specialize in Shopify development, and I have been actively learning Liquid, Online Store 2.0, and Shopify CLI to transition into this role.

My experience with technical SEO audits and structured data (JSON-LD) at mirook.com has taught me the importance of site performance and Core Web Vitals for both user experience and search visibility. I am comfortable working with Git and have an eye for design, able to translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect code. I thrive in fast-paced environments, switching between small updates and larger features, and I am fluent in English with a working knowledge of Dutch.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to work across multiple brands and contribute to the prado 2.0 project, integrating with tools like Odoo, ShipHero, and Klaviyo. I am a quick learner and am confident that my technical skills and enthusiasm will make me a valuable addition to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to prado's success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
